# REQ: LANG-1051 LANG-1052 LANG-1053 LANG-1054
package authz

import rego.v1

default allow := false

# Admins can do anything.
allow if {
    input.user.role == "admin"
}

allow if {
    some i
    input.method == "GET"
    startswith(input.path, "/public/")
    count(data.blocked[i]) < 3
    not deny
}

deny contains msg if {
    input.user.age < 18
    msg := sprintf("user %s is too young", [input.user.name])
}

raw := `raw "string"`
